given.note: Registration screen 19 (S1-27): Sam, the account owner, signed in on his registration link, connects Stripe in Lee's Barbershop's own name. Served by K-14 v1 onboardingLink (its onboarding-link.json): the business had no Stripe account, so one is made first and its id goes at once to K-23 v1 business_setup.stripe_account_id, from where every later call reads it; the page gets only Stripe's single-use link, good for 5 minutes (02-contracts K-21: 'carry only links and object keys'). Stripe is in test mode until launch (MC 8 'Payments'); the link is K-14's placeholder.
